tei:div.tei:p: (437)༄༅// rdzogs pa chen po man ngag snying thig gi bla ma brgyud pa'i rim pa mchod pa'i cho ga kun bzang rnam par rol pa'i rgyan ces bya ba bzhugs so/// /

"$ (438)༄༅// bla ma dang rang rig gdod ma'i klong la phyag 'tshal lo// sku tshe gcig gis gdod ma'i mgon po dang*// dbyer med grol gzhir zag pa zad rnams dang*// dwangs ma'i 'od skur gshegs nas 'pho ba ches// nam mkha' ji srid gzhan gyi don mdzad pa// dri med bshes gnyen mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dang*// skye 'chi gnyis spangs mtsho skyes rdo rje 'chang*// kun bzang dri med 'od zer la sogs pa// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas// de dag mchod cing gsol ba 'debs pa'i thabs// khung med bsdus dang rang bzo ma yin pa// rdo rje'i gsung gsang byin rlabs gzi brjid can// rang dang skal mnyam tshogs chen spel phyir 'god// de'ang a ti bkod pa chen po'i rgyud las// gang gis lha sku 'bum phrag bsgom pa las// bla ma'i sku la dmigs pa ma yengs na// brgya phrag stong gi char yang mi 'gro la// bsnyen sgrub bzlas pas sa ya dung phyur las// bla mar gsol 'debs lan gsum brtson gyur na// nus pa 'bum phrag char yang mi nye zhing*// gang gis rdzogs rim bskal par bsgoms pa bas// bla ma rang sems dkyil du shar tsam gyis// stong phrag nyi shu'i char yang mi phod do// zhes dang*/ gzhan yang lung las// mchod pa thams cad yongs spang nas// bla ma mchod la brtson par bya// de mnyes pas ni kun mkhyen gyi// go (439) 'phang tshe 'dir 'thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs pa ltar bla ma brnyes pa dang mchod pa ni rdo rje theg pa'i lam la zhugs pa dag gis bsgrub bya'i snying po yin la/ de dag las theg pa dang grub mtha' thams cad kyi rtse mo 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam las thog ma'i mgon po kun tu bzang po'i go 'phang mngon du mdzad pa bar ma chad du byon pa 'di dag gi mtshan tsam thos pa'ang bskal pa brgyar yang rnyed par bka' na dad cing rjes su sleb pa lta ci smos pas/ lam 'di la zhugs shing brgyud pa 'di nyid kyi rjes su slob pa'i skal ba bzang po can rnams kyis g.yar dam du bya ba ni 'di yin te// de'ang kun mkhyen klong chen rab 'byams kyi dus chen rgyal zla ba'i chos bco brgyad sogs bla ma'i dus kyi mchod pa bzung ba lta bu spros bcas dang 'brel ba'i skabs su/

gnas khang byi dor legs par byas shing rgyan gyi bkod pa'i 'byor pas brgyan// bla ma dang dkon mchog gi rten bkram pa'i mdun du stegs gtsang mar sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bu lnga pa mañdzi'i steng bkod/ mtha' bskor du chu gnyis nyer skyod brgya rtsa sogs ji tsam 'byor ba'am/ dbus su phyogs bzhir cha bzhi g.yas bskor du bsham/ mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal/ dung zhal/ me tog rnams dang*/ spro na tshogs kyi yo byad kyang nye bar bsdogs/ rgyun gyi rnal 'byor ram spros 'byor chung bas ni/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa cha (440) gcig gis mtshon ci 'byor la brten cing*/ spros med rnal 'byor ba rnams kyis ting nge 'dzin kho nas bsgrub par bya ba yin no// de la thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ chos thams cad ye nas sangs rgyas pa yin kyang*/ de ltar ma rtogs pa'i dbang gis 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i sems can snying re rje/ de thams cad rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par bya// nam mkha'i gnas su nam mkha' gang ba yi// bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang*// sangs rgyas chos dang 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la// bdag dang 'gro kun gus pas skyabs su mchi// zhes lan gsum brjod la/ /ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas la skyabs su= chos la skyabs su= dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// lan gsum gyi 'og tu/ bla ma sangs rgyas chos kyi sku la skyabs su mchi'o// bla ma longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku= bla ma cir yang sprul pa'i sku= bla ma mngon par byang chub sku la= bla ma mi 'gyur rdo rje'i sku la= drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma la skyabs su= yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la= mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la= las ngan sdig sgrib dag par byin gyis rlobs// rkyen ngan bar chad zhi bar byin= chos nyid mngon sum mthong bar= nyams snang gong du 'phel bar=

rig pa tshad la phebs par= chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes brjod/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang sogs tshad med bzhi bsgom/ bdag gi rnal 'byor ni/ gsang snying las/ mkha' dkyil dwangs pa'i dbyings nyi zla// ye shes rgyal po stangs dpyal bsgom// rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor thams cad kun// ma lus par ni bsgom par 'gyur// zhes pas rang sems ma skyes pa'i ngo bo la blo bzhag te/ rtsa ba med pa'i sems nyid 'di// chos rnams kun (441)gyi rtsa ba yin// sems nyid yi ge'i rang bzhin te// yi ge yid bzhin rin chen sprin// a ni stong dang mi stong gi /dbu ma'ang dmigs su yod ma yin// thams cad ming tsam sangs rgyas kun// yi ge phreng ba nyid la gnas// a a a zhes brjod pas// chos thams cad gcig dang du ma med pa'i ngang las nam mkha'i dbyings sprin dang bral ba'i dkyil bsgrib pa med pa la/ nyi ma dang zla ba 'od zer rab tu 'phro ba'i dkyil du dpal kun tu bzang po dang bzang mo gnyis su med pa/ mnyam par gzhag pa'i phyag rgya can chos sku'i rang bzhin rgyan cha lugs med pa las/ 'od zer kha dog lnga'i ra ba dang gur khyim gyi dbus khang bu brtsegs pa'i 'od kyis nam mkha' dbyings ma lus par khyab pas snang srid thams cad 'od du 'bar bar bsgoms la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ a a a/ zhes ci nus su brjod nas mthar nam mkha'i ngang la bzhag par bya'o// de ni sangs rgyas kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus par bsgom par 'gyur te/ dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bsgoms pa'i phyir ro// de'i ngang las skad cig gis lhar snang gsal bar bltas te/ de'ang*/ phyi dang nang gi chos thams cad mnyam pa chen po'i tshul/ rdo rje'i dbyings su gdod ma nas skye ba med pa/ rang bzhin rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang nas/ pad+ma dkar po dang zla ba'i steng du/ rang nyid rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/

g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ dar gyi na bza' dang rin po che'i rgyan can/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa'i mdzod spur 'od lnga'i thig le'i nang du oṃ dkar po// mgrin par 'od lnga'i thig le'i nang du āḥdamar po// snying gar 'od lnga'i thig le'i nang du hūm̐ sngon po gsal (442)bar gyur/ phyi dang nang kun 'og min dag pa'i zhing*// thams cad rnam dag lha dang lha mo'i ngang*// skye med lhun rdzogs 'od gsal chen po la// bdag gzhan ma lus ngang gis gnas par gyur// zhes snod bcud lha dang gzhal yas mchod pa'i rdzas rang byung lhun rdzogs ye shes chen po'i rnal rol tu bsam/ rten sgrub pa ni/ ka dag ye sangs rgyas pa'i mkha' dbyings su// lhun grub 'ja' zer thig le 'khrigs pa'i dbus// rig pa sku ru smin pa gdod ma'i mgon// ngo bo mngon sum lam ston bla ma rje// rnam pa dri med bshes gnyen 'od kyi sku// dkar ljang rab byung chas ldan paṇa zhu gsol// ting 'dzin phyag rgya tshe bum rdo rjes mtshan// rdo rje skyil krung pad zla'i gdan la bzhugs// spyi bor dga' rab rdo rje sprul sku'i chas// zla ba'i mdangs can chos 'chad phyag rgya mdzad// de yi spyi bor dpal ldan rdo rje sems// dbu gtsug kun bzang 'od mi'i 'gyur ba bzhugs// gtso bo'i mdun du pad+ma sam bha ba// g.yas rgyab g.yon du 'jam dpal bshes gnyen dang*// shrī sing ha dzñā na sū tra gsal// de mdun kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid rtsal// chos gos rnam gsum paṇa zhu zlum por gsol// sa gnon phyag rgyas ut+pal ral pod bsnams// mtha' bskor bai ro mtsho rgyal ting 'dzin bzang*// chos rgyal yab sras ldang ma lce btsun che// pad+ma las 'brel rang byung rdo rje sogs// bka' gter snying thig brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams// cha lugs ma nges gzi mdangs 'od du 'bar// skye med rdo rje'i lta stangs mkha' la gzigs// 'od gsal ting 'dzin bsam mi khyab pa'i ngang*// mos ba'i bu la brtse bas dgongs te bzhugs// gzhan yang phyogs bcu dus bzhi'i dkon mchog (443)dang*// rtsa gsum chos skyong dam can ma lus pa// rang gsal lhun rdzogs yi gdal chen por bzhugs//

de nas phyag mchod sogs tshogs gsog gi las ram la 'jug kyang chog mod/ gnyis snang gi rtog pa sel slad ye shes pa gzhug pa sogs spro na/ oṃ āḥhūm̐// chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// skye med bla ma gshegs su gsol// longs spyod rdzogs sku'i pho brang nas// gsal ngag bla ma gshegs su gsol// sprul pa sku yi pho brang nas// thugs rje can rnams gshegs su gsol// 'ja' dang 'od du kyi li li// sku dang thig le shigs se shig /spyi gtsug nyi zla'i gdan steng du// bdag dang dbyer med brtan par bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod par 'bul// sku gsum thugs kyi nyams chags bshags// smin grol dbang dang gdam pa zhu// oṃ chos sku skye ba med par gsal la dwangs// rdo rje'i sku la gsol ba 'debs// lus la bde bar byin gyis rlobs// āḥgasung 'gags pa med pa chos kyi sgra// ā li kā lir gsol ba 'debs/ ngag la nus par byin gyis rlobs// hūm̐ thugs ka dag chen po'i kun bzang klong*// cir mi dgongs la gsol= zad par 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs// de nas phyag gis bkur ba ni// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'byung gnas dpal kun tu bzang po'i rang bzhin tshad med pa'i mkhyen rab thugs rje dang ldan pa/ dpal mgon bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// bde ba chen pos rjes su bzung du gsol// gdod ma'i mgon po 'od mi 'gyur// dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas gtso// mkhyen rab ye shes rgya mtsho brnyes// (444)kun bzang yab yum la phyag 'tshal// mi gnas mi dmigs chos sku'i ngang*// 'od gsal ye shes longs spyod rdzogs// yid bzhin rin chen gter mnga' ba// zhi khro rab 'byams la= mi 'gyur kun 'gro ye shes bdag /bde chen chos mchog mi g.yo ba// bla med yid bzhin rin chen gter// rdo rje 'chang chen la=

'od gsal ye shes sgyu ma'i lha// mtshan rdzogs dpe byad dpal 'bar zhing*// sku gsum lhun grub rdzogs sangs rgyas// rdo rje sems dpa' la= /rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen gyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje 'dzin// mthu stobs dbang phyug 'gro ba'i yab// phyag na rdo rje la= thabs dang shes rab pha rol phyin// rnam grol ye shes rgya mtsho brnyes// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag mchog gyur pa// dga' rab rdo rje la= bla med grub pa mchog brnyes shing*// gsung rab yid bzhin 'byung ba'i mdzod// 'gro la chos kyi char 'debs pa'i// 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la= mkhyen brtse brtson pa'i nam mkha' la// ye shes nyi ma'i 'od brdal bas// phyogs bcu'i mun pa sel mdzad pa// shrī sing ha la= /rnam dag thugs rje'i dkyil 'khor las// phan bde'i ye shes 'od 'phro bas// 'phro ba'i lam bzang snang mdzad pa// dzñā na sū tra la= /mkhyen rtse'i 'od stong bla med kyis// gsung rab pad+mo kha 'byed cing*// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun sel ba// bi ma mi tra la= /rang byung pad+ma'i sdong po la// nyi shar sangs rgyas pad+ma skyes// mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba// pad+ma 'byung gnas la= /sa mchog dkyil 'khor chen po brnyes// mkhyen brtse'i brtson pa dpag yas shing*// rnam 'phrul du mas 'gro kun skyong*// chos rgyal khri srong la= /ting nge 'dzin dang (445)gzugs rnams kyi// gter gyur 'od gsal sgyu ma'i sku// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul dbang sgyur ba'i// ting 'dzin bzang po la/ zab mo'i dam chos mdzod 'dzin cing*// bar dor 'od gsal snying po brnyes// brtse chen thabs mkhas thugs rje'i bdag /ldang ma lhun rgyal la= /rnam grol brtson pa'i stobs chen gyis// zag med ye shes bdud rtsi brnyes// 'od skur yon tan lhun rdzogs pa'i// seng ge dbang phyug la= /thabs dang shes rab mnyam sbyor zhing*// rtag tu zag med 'od gsal ngang*// mi 'gyur lhun grub rdzogs par bzhugs// rgyal ba zhang ston la=

/sa chen gzungs sprin snying po can// rnam grol ye shes mchog rab brnyes// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa sel// mkhas pa nyi 'bum la= /bla med tshogs chen rab rdzogs shing*// rnam kun mchog ldan stong pa'i gzugs// nges don snying po'i don rtogs pa'i// gu ru jo 'ber la= yang dag sgyu ma'i tshul brnyes shing*// stong nyid snying rje'i bdag nyid can// rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing bgrod pa// seng ge rgyab pa la phyag 'tshal// chos nyid bden pa rab gzigs shing*// ye shes rol pa'i brtul zhugs kyis// dpag med 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa// grub chen me longs la= /rnam dag 'od gsal snying po'i zhing*// rtag tu rang bzhin lhun 'grub cing*// mngon shes gzung sprin yid bzhin gter// ku mā rā ja la= /shes bya'i dkyil 'khor rab gzigs shing*// dam chos rin chen mdzod 'dzin pas// zab mo'i dgongs gter rgyas mdzad pa// kun mkhyen chos rje la= /byams dang snying rje'i dkyil 'khor nas// phan bde'i 'od zer spro mdzad cing*// mngon sum dbang po'i yul ston pa// khyab brdal (446lhun grub= zag med ye shes sgyu ma'i sku// 'gro 'ong rtag chad mtha' las 'das// shes bya'i dkyil 'khor mngon gzigs pa// grags pa 'od zer la= /'gro ba kun la bu ltar du// brtse ba chen po'i thugs rje yis// rtag par rjes su 'dzin mdzad pa// 'khrul zhig chen po la= /rig gnas shes bya'i gnas kun mkhyen// thugs rjes gzhan phan phrin las mdzad// spyan ras gzigs sprul 'gro ba'i yab// zla ba grags pa la= /sgrib pa kun las rnam grol zhing*// bsam gtan ting 'dzin mchog dang ldan// snang bzhi mthar phyin chos kyi sku// kun bzang rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// dam chos rin chen rgyal mtshan 'dzin// smin grol 'dod rgu'i chos char 'debs// dpal ldan skal bzang kun dga'i gnyen// rgyal mtshan dpal bzang=

/rang gzhan don gnyis lhun gyis grub// theg mchog chos kyi rgyal srid skyong*// snying rje'i lam bzang gsal mdzad pa// sna tshogs rang gol la= /gnyis 'dzin 'khrul pa rang sar zhig /spang blang re dog dbyings su grol// 'gyur med bde chen ye shes brnyes// bstan 'dzin grags pa la= mdo sngags rgya mtsho'i mthar son nas// nges gsang bstan pa'i yid bzhin nor// 'dod rgur rtsol mdzad rig pa 'dzin// mdo sngags bstan 'dzin la= /rgyal ba kun gyi snying po'i lam// ma nor ston mdzad rdo rje 'chang*// 'gran zla kun bral chos kyi rje// phrin las lhun grub la= /'gyur med ye shes spyi yi gzugs// rdo rje'i theg mchog ston pa che// 'jigs bral phyogs las rgyal ba'i lha// 'gyur med rdo rje la phyag 'tshal// lta spyod zung du 'jug pa yis// ting 'dzin mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// bla med snying po'i (447)bstan pa 'dzin// rin chen rnam rgyal= /rang byung ye shes bsgom pa nyid// bar mtshams med par rab rtogs nas// 'gro kun sangs rgyas sar 'god pa// mi 'gyur dpal sgron la= /thugs rje rang shar rig pa nyid// rang grol chos skur rab rtogs nas// tshad med phrin las gzhan don 'grub// au ṭī ya na la phyag 'tshal// rang byung gdod nas dag pa'i klong*// 'khor 'das gzhi grol mnyam pa nyid// rtogs pa mchod gyur 'gro ba 'dren// phrin las rnam rgyal la= phyogs bral rtogs pa'i nam mkha' la// 'od gsal nyi zla'i dkyil 'khor gsal// 'gro ba'i ma rig mun pa bsal// dharma tā rā la= ji lta ji snyed mkhyen pa rgyas// brtse bas mkha' mnyam rab bsgral nas// thams cad gdod mar 'khrig mdzad pa// rdo rje gzi brjid la= ye grol blo 'das ngang nyid nas// rang bab lhug par nyams blangs shing*// 'gro la snying rjes ma ltar brtse// rtsa ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal//

rin rnam nas 'di bar rdzogs chen gsang skor gyi phyag 'tshal cung zad kha bsgyur ba'o// ngo bo brjod 'das nam mkha'i klong*// rang bzhin 'od gsal longs spyod rdzogs// thugs rjes 'gro kun yongs la khyab// skyabs mchog khyod la=snying rje'i klong du ye nas grol// gsal snang zhing khams chen por rgyas// thams cad mnyam sbyor nam mkha'i ngang*// dpe bral khyod la= ye nas kun bzang rol pa'i ngang*// khyod ni rtag tu mnyam gzhag kyang*// nor ba dri bzhin gzhan don mdzad// yid bzhin khyod la= ting nge 'dzin dang mngon shes kyis// gdul bya'i 'jig rten ma lus kun// gdod ma'i dbyings su khrid mdzad pa// ded dpon khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// 'khor ba (448)mgon med rab 'khyams shing*// sdug bsngal rgya mtsho'i klong yangs las// sgrol bar mdzad pa'i gru bo che// brtse chen khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// las dang nyon mongs 'khrul 'khor gyis// yun ring srid par dub pa la// spang gnyen rang grol mngon sum lam// ston mchog khyod la= gang zhig mthong bas rab dad cing*// thos pas the tshom drwa ba gcod// reg pas byin rlabs dngos grub 'byung*// mtshungs bral khyod la= gang zhig khyod sku mthong ba dang*// khyed gsung thos dang 'dzin pa yi// 'gro ba de dag kun la yang*// rtag tu bdag ni phyag 'tshal lo// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*// dkyil 'khor lhun grub byang chub sems// chos dang 'phags pa'i tshogs mchog la// rab tu gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sku gzugs mchod rten la sogs pa// 'gro ba'i bsod nams zhing gi mchog /ma lus ji snyed thams cad la// kun nas dwang bas= 'khor 'das kun gyi byang chub sems// bla med 'od gsal snying po mchog /bde gshegs snying po'i khams nyid la// ngo mtshar chen pos= thar pa'i lam du zhugs rnams dang*// dkon mchog sgra dbyangs thos so 'tshal// sems can kun gyi rigs kun la// rnam grol slad du=

/snang srid snod bcud thams cad kun// ye nas kun bzang rol pa'i ngang*// gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag pas// gnyis med ngang du phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma bshes gnyen dam pa khyod// bdag cag rnams kyi mgon lags so// mi shes rmongs pa'i blo gros mkhan// lam stor rnams kyi lam mkhan lags// mun khung 'khyams pa'i sgron ma ste// gdung ba sel ba'i rin po che// nyi ma'i (449)zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// zla ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal 'dud// pad+ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal 'dud// 'di ltar dga' dang gus pa yis// bsngags dang 'dud pas phyag bgyi'o// ho// rdzogs sangs rin chen dag pa'i sems nyid dang*// rtogs pa'i dri ma rab bral dam pa'i chos// brtul zhugs bzang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing*// sred dang bral ba rnams la gus phyag 'tshal// deng nas bdag ni 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i phyir// mgon rnams 'bangs su bdag nyid 'bul lags kyis// brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzhes par mdzad du gsol// byams pa'i zhal bzang dus 'dir gzigs nas kyang*// 'gal 'khrul nyams chags thams cad skong gyur cig / de nas mchod pa rnams kyi gtso bor thog mar sku gsum gyi maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ maṇ+ḍal legs par phyis te dri bzang gi chab kyis byug /dang po la tshom bu bco lnga/ bar pa la dgu/ tha ma la lnga bkod la rim par 'bul ba/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ ri'i rgyal bo ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po// lho 'dzam bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod// byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ gser gyi ri bdun/ rol pa'i mtsho bdun/ rgyal srid rin po che sna bdun/ bkra shis kyi rdzas brgyad/ gter gyi bum pa/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /yid du 'ong ba'i 'dod yon/ shing tu mdzes pa'i lha mo// nyi ma/

zla ba/ dbus su lha dang mi'i 'dod pa'i yon tan ma tshang ba med pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams rgya mtsho legs par bkod de/ bcom ldan dpal rnam par snang mdzad la sogs (450)pa phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga gangs chen mtsho'i sku dang gsung dang thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo la brten pa'i zhing khams 'byams klas tshangs chen gyi bskal ba chen pos legs par brgyan pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po bsam gyis mi khyab par dmigs te 'bul lo// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed ri rab gling bzhi'i 'jig rten khams// lha dang mi'i 'dod yon phun tshogs bde gshegs mchod pa'i sprin phung can// tshang chen bskal pas legs par brgyan te dge legs rgya mtsho'i bsod nams zhing*/ bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// rin chen maṇ+ḍal yid 'ong mchod pa'i sprin// rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'di phul bas// rang bzhin sprul sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'og min gyi gnas rnam dag stug po bkod pa bde ba'i zhing*/ thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa'i zhing khams na// shin tu yid du 'ong ba'i gzhal med khang chen po// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi dang ldan ba la/ rin po che'i gdugs/ chos kyi 'khor lo// shin tu mdzes pa'i ri dwags/ lha yi gos rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ yid du 'ong ba'i 'phan zla ba rlung gis skyod pa// rnga yab nor bu'i yu ba can/ gser gyi dril bu'i g.yer kha'i phreng ba/ rdo rje dang nor bu rin po che'i tog /rtsigs pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu/ nor bu sna tshogs kyi drwa phyed/ dho kra ma shi 000'i mda' yab/

rin po che'i dra mig /(451)gseng ma'i spu shu/ rab tu mtho ba'i phyur bu/ 'dod yon gyi snam bu/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ zhal zas ma/ sil snyan ma/ mchod pa'i sprin phung chen po bsam gyis mi khyab pas phyi nang kun tu yang legs par bkod pa'i gnas tshangs pa rnga sgra'i zhing khams chen po ye shes rin po che'i sprin gyi dra bas legs par brgyan pa 'di nyid bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lor 'bul lo// bde chen gnas ni shin tu mtha' yas bkod pa'i sprin gyi 'od zer can// gru bzhi sgo bzhi rta babs bzhi ldan ye shes rnam lnga'i rtsigs pas brgyan// sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar mchod pa'i sprin gyi 'od 'phro ba// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// 'og min bde chen rin chen gzhal yas khang*// sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyi bla bre can// nam mkha' gang bar dmigs te phul ba yi// lhun grub longs sku'i zhing la spyod par shog /oṃ āḥhūm̐/ chos nyid 'od gsal gyi zhing khams gdod ma nas ngo bo nyid kyis rnam par dag cing*/ nam mkha' ltar stong la mtha' dbus med pa/ nyi zla ltar bkra zhing lhun gyis grub pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa gang du yang ma phyes mi 'byed 'byed pa med pa'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas kyi zhing dang 'gro ba drug gi rnam par 'phrul pa dpag tu med pa'i 'byung gnas chen por/ lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs/ sku gsum 'du 'bral (452)med pa'i klong*/ dus bzhi mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ gzhon nu bum pa sku'i zhing khams/ phyi dang nang med par kun tu yang nang du gyur pa/ sngon po dang*/ ser po dang*/ dmar po dang*/

dkar po dang*/ ljang gu'i 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro zhing*/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas par sku dang ye shes kyi snang ba chen pos legs par brgyan pa'i bkod pa tshad med pa'i mnga' thang chen po la dbang 'byor ba 'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i zhing khams rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag cing lhun gyis grub pa 'di nyid/ bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la/ dgongs klong rnam par dag pa'i ngang du ye shes kyi mchod pa dam par 'bul lo// gdod nas rnam dag 'od gsal zhing ni ma skyes lhun rdzogs 'dus ma byas// sna tshogs mi dmigs spros kun nyer zhi ye shes rnam lnga'i gzhal yas khang*// sku gsum mdzad pa'i 'od zer dang bcas rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i gnas// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// 'od gsal lhun grub ye shes rigs lnga'i zhing*// sku dang thig les ye nas brgyan pa 'di// rang snang dag pas legs par phul ba yis// kun bzang chos sku'i zhing la spyod par shog / ces dang*/ slar yang thun mong ba'i maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba ni/ yang maṇ+ḍal lan gsum phyis bas sgo gsum gyi dri ma dag nas/ bh+rūṃ las sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams dag par gser gyi ri dang*/ gling dang*/ sa gzhi mdzes pa la/ 'dod pa dang gzugs khams kyi lha dang ma'i 'dod yon dpag tu med pa dang*/ gzugs med pa'i ting nge 'dzin dga' bde dang*/ zhing dag pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ rin po che'i shing ljon pa la sogs dang*/ nyan thos dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ sangs rgyas kyi dga' bde dpag tu med par gang bar bsam la/ (453) tshom bu lnga dang*/ brgyad dang*/ bcu gnyis bkod pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sna tshogs khams can sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid ma lus kun khyab gzugs dang bkod pa dpag yas rgya mtsho'i snying po gangs can mtshos brgyan lha mi'i bkod sprin nam mkha'i dbyings tsam de snyed rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas mchod 'os rnams la gus pas 'bul/

gser gyi sa gzhi ri dbang lhun pos brgyan// gling bzhi gling phran nyi zla gza' skar bkram// lha mi'i 'dod yon phun tshogs dang ldan pa// gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod/ rin chen chu mtsho me tog gis bkram rnam dag pad+ma'i gzhal yas chu dbang yid bzhin dbang pos nyer bsten sa 'og sa steng sa bla bar snang la gnas khang brtsegs yid 'ong rnam mang lha yi skyed tshal 'od dang gzi brjid dpal du 'bar bas 'gro ba'i bla ma sras bcas mchod/ gser dang dngul dang rin chen in dra nī la// mar gad mus gar bha*// yid bzhin nor bu sna tshogs mdzes 'bar ba// bum bzang dpag bsam shing chen rnams kyis mchod// pad+ma ku mu ta dang ut+pal dri ldan mdangs bkra yid 'ong kha bye lhag ger gsal gyur nor bu'i gdub bu yid 'ong 'khrol bas mdzes byas lha mi'i bu mo bstod dbyangs sgrogs ldan gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra dbyangs mtho ris sa steng dpal 'byor rnams kyis mchod/ rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rnam pa brgyad/ gzhal med khang mdzes yid 'ong nyams dga' ba// mi dbang dpal phreng phun tshogs 'di phul bas// rgyal ba'i 'byor tshogs lhun gyis grub gyur cig /bsam gtan lha gnas shin tu nyams dga' dwangs pa 'od kyis gzhal yas khang bkram gzugs bzang lha mang gis mdzes (454)bsam gtan zhi ba'i skyed mos tshal gcig mi g.yo gzugs dang gzugs med ye shes rol pa'i ting nge 'dzin la reg srid gsum snod bcud dngos dang dngos med bde dga' rgya mtsho rnams kyis mchod/ nyan thos rang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// rgyal ba'i gzungs sprin snying po las thon pa// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i yis// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs mchod// dag pa'i zhing khams rgyal sras 'byor pas yongs gang lha mi'i bde 'byung rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i sprin phung dang bcas ye shes las grub gzhal yas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab longs sku'i zhing gi dpal 'byor chos sku'i zhing gi snying po ma lus yongs bkod bde chen rgya mtshor 'gro kun phyam gcig bgrod par shog

/rin chen maṇ+ḍal kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// srid zhi'i 'byor tshogs dpag med dang ldan pa// phun tshogs bsod nams zhing la spyod pa yis// 'gro kun thar pa'i grong du phyin par shog / ces phul bas thun mong gi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas zhing khams dag pa la spyod pa'i dgos ched yod do// de nas khyad par gyi tshogs gnyis rdzogs nas ye shes lnga'i zhing khams la spyod par bya ba'i phyir// lnga tshan lnga'i maṇ+ḍal tshom bur bkod la zhing khams thams cad spos kyi dri dang*// 'bru dang*/ sman dang*/ rin po che dang*/ me tog sna tshogs kyis bkang bar dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ yid bzhin rin po che'i sprin gyi drwa ba kun nas brgyan pa'i zhing khams/ gser gyi sa gzhi rin po che'i ri bo// sman gyi nags tshal/ spos kyi sprin phung*/ 'bru'i bang mdzod/ me tog gi skyed mos tshal/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu la sogs pa lha dang mi'i mchod pa'i sprin phung dpag tu med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas pas bkang ste bla ma dang yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs (455)dang bcas pa rnams la ji srid 'khor ba ma stong gi bar du rtag pa rgyun gyi 'khor lo 'bul lo// zhing khams thams cad gser gyi sa gzhi kun nas mdzes pa'i snying po la/ rin chen sna tshogs bsil ma bkram shing yid 'ong nor bu'i 'od 'bar bas// mtha' dang dbus med nam mkha'i dbyings khyab dpag yas mchod pa'i sprin phung 'di// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// kun nas mdzes pa'i rin chen sna tshogs kyis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste 'bul ba yi// 'gro kun gnas skabs dgos 'dod lhun grub cing*// mthar thug ye shes lnga la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad sna tshogs 'bru mang kun nas bkram pa'i sa gzhi la// sman shing me tog lo tog rab rgyas dul ba'i 'bras bus rab tu phyug

/khang brtsegs 'bru mang 'byor pas yongs gang yid 'ong gzhal yas khang*// bsam gtan ro brgya'i zas kyi rjes 'gro 'dod rgu'i dpal 'byung dam pa 'di// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// 'bru mang 'byor ba shin tu dpag yas kyis// nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis// 'gro kun gnas skabs 'byor pa mtha' yas shing*// mthar thug sku lnga'i zhing la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad dri gtsang gis khyab sems kyi sa gzhi bstar ba la/ tsan dan sna tshogs phye ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa bkod gyur cing*// spos kyi dpag bsam chu mtsho rab brgyan dri zhim dwangs pa'i mchod sprin 'di// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung 'di// (456)nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis// 'gro kun gnas skabs dbang po rab gsal zhing*// mthar thug kun bzang zhing la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad sman gyi sa gzhi rab tu dwangs pas brgyan pa la// sman gyi ri bo shin tu dpag med kun nas bkod pas mdzes par bkang*// bkra shis gzi brjid dpal du 'bar bas nad kun zhi bar byed pa 'di// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// sman mchog bdud rtsi'i mchod sprin dam pa 'di// nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis// 'gro kun gnas skabs tshe ring nad med cing*// mthar thug bde chen zhing la spyod par shog /zhing khams thams cad rin chen sil mas bkang bar gyur pa la// pad+ma'i mtsho dang me tog khang brtsegs ut+pal dra bas sbrel legs pa// dus 'dir lha yi me tog char 'babs sa dang bar snang brgyan pa 'di// bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul// yid 'ong sna tshogs rin chen mdzes 'bar bas// nam mkha'i mtha' klas bkang ste phul ba yis// 'gro kun gnas skabs shes rab rgya che zhing*// mthar thug 'od lnga'i zhing la spyod par shog

ces 'bul lo// 'dis ni tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa dang*/ longs spyod ldan pa dang*/ snang ba bzhi'i ye shes gong du 'phel ba la sogs pa yon tan dpag tu med par gsungs so// de ltar maṇ+ḍal rigs gsum ma lcogs na thun mong gi maṇ+ḍal tsam mam/ sku gsum maṇ+ḍal kho na bya'o// gang ltar de'i rjes 'brel du mchod pa'i yo byad sna tshogs pa 'bul ba ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'byung ba chen po nam mkha' che// 'byung ba chen po lnga yi mdzod// nam mkha' las ni 'dod pa 'byung*// 'dod pa'i mchod pa 'byung gyur cig /na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te (457)badz+ra sā ra pra mar+dha ne/ ta thā ga tā ya/ ār+ha ta samyak+saṃ bud+dha ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ badz+re badz+re/ ma hā badz+re/ ma hā te dzo badz+re/ ma hā bid+yā badz+re/ ma hā bodhi maṇ+ḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badz+ra sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi shodha na badz+re swā hā/ zhes sngags lan gsum gyis byin rlabs la/ dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis rnam sprul pa'i// mchod pa bla med rgya chen rnams kyis mchod// me tog spos dang mar me zhal zas chu// bla re 'phan lding gdugs dang rol mo'i sgra// rgyal mtshan rnga yab rdza rnga la sogs dang*// lus dang longs spyod mkho dgu'i yo byad kyis// 'gro ba'i bla ma dkon mchog sras bcas mchod// lha sogs 'jig rten kun na yid 'ong ba'i// gzhal med khang brtsegs rin chen drwa ba can// glu gar sil snyan bstod dbyangs char 'bar cing*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag mnga' ba rnams kyi mchod// rin chen ri bo nags tshal pad+ma'i mtsho// ngang mo'i 'gros kyis gnyer ba de dag dang*// sman sogs dri zhim ngad ldang dpag bsam shing*// me tog 'bras bus dud pa'i tshogs kyis mchod// 'dab stong g.yo bas bung pa bzung ba yi// lag pa'i gdu bu ku mu tas mtshan zhing*// sprin bral nyi zla'i zer gyis rab phye ba'i// ut+pal sogs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// tsan dan bsil bas kha yi sbubs bskyod pa'i// dri zhim ser bu bde ba'i ngad rnams dang*// phug dang brag ri sman ljongs nyams dga' ba// chu bsil rdzing bus gang ba rnams kyis mchod// ston ka'i mtshan mo dkar ba'i ri bong 'dzin// gza' bral rgyu skar phreng bas bskor ba dang*// nyin byed 'od stong drwa bas mdzes 'bar ba// gling bzhi'i 'jig rten rgyan gyur rnams kyis mchod// khor yug rir bcas bye ba phrag (458)brgya'i zhing*// ma lus yongs bkod 'dod dgus 'byor ba dang*// phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed kun// blo yis blangs te thub dbang sras bcas mchod// bum bzang dpag bsam shing dang 'dod 'jo'i ba// rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad dang*// nye ba'i rin chen bdun sogs rgya che bas// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams mchod// ting 'dzin yid kyis nam mkha'i dbyings khyab par// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// me tog sprin mdzes lding khang mdzes 'bar ba// spos dang sman sbyar bdud rtsi'i sprin phung dang*// gzi ldan sgrol ma zhal zas rol mo'i sprin// bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtsho'i sprin gyis mchod// 'jug pa'i sprin can shin tu mtha' yas pa// sgeg mo phreng thogs rin chen glu gar sogs// mchod pa'i lha mo sna tshogs sprin 'phro bas// rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus mnyes gyur cig

/ de nas sdig pa bshags pa ni nyes pa'i las la 'gyod sems mchi ma 'khrugs pa tsam du bskyed la/ kye kye bla ma rin po che// bdag la re sa gzhan na med// mgon med bdag la skyabs mdzod la// thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs su gsol// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// ma rig 'thib po'i bdud kyis mnan// mgon po khyod dang khyod kyi sras// rdo rje spun la sogs pa la// brnyas shing ma dad sems la sogs// rtsa ba yan lag nyams la sogs// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba rnams// 'gyod tshangs chen pos dus 'dir bshags// skad cig nyid la byang bar mdzod// kye ma 'khor ba thog med nas// ma 'tshal bzhin du sdig bgyis pas// sngar yang 'khor ba rab tu 'khyams// da yang 'khyams par gyur pa la// skyabs dang skyob par mdzad du gsol// 'di ltar mi shes byis pa la// skyon gyur mthong (459)lhag par yang*// thugs rjes gzigs pa 'jug par rigs// 'di ltar 'jig rten phal pa yang*// bu yis nyes pa gang bgyis pa// ma yis sel zhing skyong la gzigs// thugs rjes mnga' dbang 'gro ba'i yab// bdag cag 'gro drug sems can rnams// gzigs nas thugs rjes mi 'dzin na// khyod kyi phrin las gdul bya la// phan ces grags pa ji ltar rung*// sngon gyi rgyal ba grangs med kyang*// bdag cag spangs nas thar par gshegs// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas rnams kyang*// gcig pur zhi la rab tu gzhol// khyod kyang de ltar gshegs mdzad dam// phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba thams cad kyis// khyod la bskul nas bdag cag gi /don du bla mar rnam 'phrul na// khyod kyis bdag cag 'dor phod dam// 'jigs sar skyel mas bsrus pa bzhin// khyod kyis di ring bslu mdzad dam// de ltar na yang rang gi las// rnam par smin ces dgongs mdzad na// las dang bral ba de dag la// thugs rjes dgongs kyang ci zhig 'tshal// sha za rnams kyang mchod sbyin dang*// bden pa'i tshig ni brjod ma thag

/sngon gyi khro ba 'dor bgyid na// khyod ni brtse chen 'gro ba'i yab// nyes pa bshags la cis mi dgongs// yid bzhin nor bu rin chen kyang*// gsol ba btab na 'dod rgur sbyin// khyod ni brtse chen thabs mkhas la// ci slad re ba skong mi mdzad// kye ma mgon po thugs rje can// bdag gi sdig kun ma byang bar// skye ba gzhan tu song gyur na// dmyal me bzod dkas yun ring bsreg /de ltar gyur kyang mi skyobs na// snying rje'i bdag nyid ji ltar lags// kye ma kye hud bdag gi sdig /ma lus byang bar mdzad du gsol// skad cig 'di la thugs (460)dgongs la// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub rtsol// bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol// tshe 'dir bsam pa kun 'grub cing*// nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' ba dang*// dus min 'chi ba bzlog pa dang*// 'chi khar gnad gcod med pa dang*// bar do'i 'od gsal 'byongs pa dang*// mkha' spyod gnas su khrid par mdzod// ces gdung ba'i gsol ba btab pas/ bdag gi nyams chags bskangs nas shin tu dgyes par bsam mo// yan lag lhag ma ni/ thog med dus nas goms pa'i bag chags kyis// las dang nyon mongs sdig pa ci bgyis pa// srid pa'i rgyur gyur de kun bshags par bgyi// 'gro ba'i bsod nams phung po mtha' yas la// rtag par bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// ma lus skye dgu'i tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med bskor bar bskul// deng nas srid pa'i rgya mtsho ma stong bar// mya ngan mi 'da' rtag tu bzhugs par gsol// dge ba 'di yis bdag dang 'gro ba kun// ma lus phyam gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog / de nas bstod cing gsol ba 'debs pa ni gter chen rin po ches mdzad pa'i paṇa chen bi ma la dang o rgyan chen po// kun mkhyen klong chen pa'i gsol 'debs kyis mtshon bla ma so so'i sku bstod gsol 'debs kyi rigs dang*/

spyi la snying thig dang yang tig sems klong brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ji tsam nus pa bya/ thams cad ma nus na yang tig yid bzhin nor bu'i gsol 'debs yid bzhin sprin phung brgyud pa'i kha bskang dang bcas pa 'di tsam zhig bya ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gdod ma'i mgon po kun bzang yab yum la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes spyan gyis gzigs// rang byung sems nyid 'od gsal snying po'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis brlob// lhun grub rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rjes spyan gyis gzigs// rang gsal (461)ye shes sgron me 'od po che// da lta nyid du mthong bar byin gyis rlobs// bde chen rgyal po rdo rje 'chang chen la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i= 'khor 'das gzhi grol sems nyid chos sku'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// ye shes sgyu ma rdo rje sems dpa' la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// mi 'gyur lhun grub bde chen 'og min du// da lta nyid du bgrod par= dkyil 'khor mnga' bdag phyag na rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i= gsang sngags rgyal po tshe gcig sangs rgyas lam// da lta nyid du bgrod par= rgyal ba'i rnam sprul dga' rab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= gdos bcas phung po ye shes 'od lus su// da lta nyid du grol bar= mkhyen rab sprul pa 'jam dpal bshes gnyen la// gsol ba 'debs= las dbang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// da lta nyid du sgrol bar= blo mchog mnga' ba shrī siṃ ha la// gsol ba= /chos tshul rgya mtshos gsung rab nor bu'i gling*// da lta nyid du bgrod par= /dngos grub mchog brnyes dzñā na sū tra la// gsol ba= /mchog dang thun mongs dngos grub yid bzhin sprin// da lta nyid du 'grub par= /mkhas grub chen po bi ma mi tra la// gsol ba=

/mngon sum 'od gsal snang ba rnam pa bzhi// da lta nyid du 'byongs par= /rang byung chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la// gsol ba 'debs so= /bgegs dang logs 'dren bar chad ma lus pa/ da lta nyid du zhi bar= /sems nyid dbang thob ting 'dzin bzang po la// gsol ba= /nyin mtshan gnyis med 'od gsal chen po'i ngang*// da lta nyid du 'byongs par= /tshogs chen gnyis rdzogs chos rgyal chen po la// gsol (462)ba= /'phags pa'i nor bdun yon tan rgyal srid mchog /da lta nyid du thob par= /thar gling snang mdzad ldang ma lhun rgyal la// gsol ba= /'gro kun phyam gcig byang chub snying po'i sar// da lta nyid du sgrol bar= /'od gsal lus grub seng ge dbang phyug la= /gsol ba 'debs so= /'khrul snang rang zad gdod ma'i gzhi dbyings su// da lta nyid du 'jug par= /lhun grub rgyal po rgyal ba zhang ston la// gsol ba= /sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par= /gsung rab mdzod brnyes mkhas pa nyi 'bum la/ gsol ba= /ye shes nyi mas ma rig mun pa'i tshogs// da lta nyid du sangs par= /dam chos rgyas mdzad gu ru jo 'ber la= /gsol ba= /gzhan don rdzogs pa'i phrin las rlabs po che// da lta nyid du 'grub par byin gyis rlobs/ gzung 'dzin 'khrul zhig seng ge rgyab ba la// gsol ba 'debs so thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs// 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang tshe 'di'i zhen pa kun// da lta nyid du zad par= dngos grub mchog brnyes grub chen me long la= /gsol ba 'debs so= /don gnyis lhun grub 'od gsal chos nyid ngang*// da lta nyid du phyin par/ rig 'dzin chen po ku mā rā dza la// gsol ba= /rtogs pa'i 'od 'bar thugs rje'i sprin phung mchog /da lta nyid du 'char ba= /'od gsal sgyu ma sna tshogs rang grol la// gsol ba= /snang srid snod bcud rmi lam sgyu ma ru// da lta nyid du 'byongs bar=

/mkhas grub chen po khyab brdal lhun grub la// gsol ba= /byams dang snying rje byang chub sems mchog 'di// da lta nyid du 'byongs= /rgyal sras sprul skur grags pa'i 'od zer la// gsol ba= /'od gsal rdo rje snying po'i bstan pa 'di// da lta nyid du rgyas par= /'khrul zhig chen po sangs rgyas dpon po la// (463)gsol ba= /snying po med pa tshe 'di'i bya ba kun// da lta nyid du mthong bar= /rta mchog sprul pa zla ba grags pa la// gsol ba= /'khor 'das chos kun thig le nyag gcig tu// da lta nyid du rtogs par= /mtshungs med grub chen kun bzang rdo rje la// gsol ba= /dbyings rig dbyer med 'od gsal chos sku'i don// da lta nyid du rtogs par= /zab lam rgyas mdzad kun dga' rgyal mtshan la// gsol ba= /chos kun mnyam nyid 'od gsal klong yangs su// da lta nyid du grol bar= /bstan pa'i sgron me sna tshogs rang grol la// gsol ba= gzung 'dzin 'khrul rtog gdod ma'i mkha' dbyings su// da lta nyid du dwangs par= /'khrul zhig chen po bstan 'dzin grags pa la// gsol ba= /snang bzhi mthar phyin ye shes 'od kyi lus// da lta nyid du 'grub par= /shes bya kun gzigs mdo sngags bstan 'dzin la// gsol ba= /rang don rdzogs nas phrin las rlabs po che// da lta nyid du 'grub par= /nub chen yang srid phrin las lhun grub la// gsol ba= /stong gsal ka dag chos nyid zad sa ru// da lta nyid du 'khyol bar= /khams sum chos kyi rgyal po gter bdag gling*// gsol ba= /don gnyis mthar phyin phrin las rnam pa bzhi// da lta nyid du 'grub par= /bi mi'i rnam 'phrul rin chen rnam rgyal la= /gsol ba= /bstan 'gror phan pa'i bsam sbyor rlabs po che// da lta nyid du skye bar= /mtsho rgyal dngos snang mi 'gyur dpal sgron la// gsol ba= /'khrul rtog rlung sems chos nyid zad pa'i ngang*// da lta nyid du stong par=

/g.yu sgra'i sgyu 'phrul au ḍī ya na la// gsol ba= /gzung rtog yul snang bden med gzhi bral dang*// da lta nyid du grol bar= /'jam dpal rnam rol phrin las rnam rgyal la// gsol ba= /'dzin rtog rig pa stong gsal zang thal (464)ngang*// da lta nyid du grol bar= /nyams rtogs dbang phyug phrin las chos sgron la// gsol ba= /bya bral chos nyid klong du bdag 'dzin kun// da lta nyid du zhig par= /thams cad mkhyen pa mañdzu gha ṣa la// gsol ba= /ma nges sprul pas mkha' khyab 'gro ba'i don// da lta nyid du 'grub par= /bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= /ye grol gnyug ma blo las 'das pa'i zhal// da lta nyid du mjal bar= / dkyus su mi dgos kyang bla ma mchod pa'i skabs brgyud la gzhan mdor bsdus te kha bskang bar spro na/ /ting 'dzin bzang po blo gros dbang phyug dang*// rin chen 'bar ba lhun gyi rgyal mtshan sogs// gsang skor brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol ba= /chos nyid zad sar 'khyol bar byin gyis rlobs// bai ro tsa na spang ston mi pham mgon// byang chub rgyal mtshan rin chen dbyig la sogs// klong sde brgyud pa'i bla mar gsol= /gdos bcas 'od du dengs par byin gyis rlobs// bai ro g.yu sgra chos rgyal khri lde'i zhabs// gnyags dang gnubs chen zur pa mes dbon sogs// sems sde brgyud pa'i bla mar= /'khrul snang gzhi thog grol bar= /pad+ma las 'brel rgyal sras legs pa dang*// ngag gi dbang po rang byung rdo rje sogs// snying tig brgyud pa'i bla mar=snang bzhi mtha' ru phyin par byin gyis rlobs/ khyab brdal lhun grub nas 'di bar kha skong du bgyis pa'o// gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas dang*// nyan thos rang rgyal 'phags pa'i tshogs rnams dang*// chos mdzad yongs la gus pas gsol= /thugs rjes gzigs shing byin gyis rlabs tu gsol// kye ma kye hud nyams thag bdag lta bu// las dang nyon mongs bzod dkas yun ring mnar// 'di la brtse chen thugs rje'i phyag rkyongs la// da lta nyid du drang bar mdzad du gsol// rang nyid ye nas sangs (465)rgyas yin mod kyang*// ma rig 'khrul pas srid pa 'dir 'khyams ste// rmi lam lta bu'i 'khor ba nyam re thag

/'di la skyabs dang skyobs par mdzad du gsol// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis// 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho mtha' med brgal dka' bas// ye shes gru chen bla na med pa yis// sdug bsngal chu bo sgrol bar mdzad du gsol// yun ring dus nas goms pa'i bag chags gzugs// 'khrul snang gzung 'dzin ri rgyal lhun mtho ba// rnam grol mchog gi ye shes rdo rje yis// da lta nyid du gzhig par mdzad= /ma rig mun pa shin tu 'thibs po che// rgyun ring rtag dka' pha mtha' mi mngon zhing*// 'od gsal snying po'i sgrib pa rlabs chen 'di// ye shes zer gyis gsal bar= /ji tsam 'bad kyang nyon mongs sdug bsngal rgyu// snying po med pa'i 'jig rten bya ba las// bdag gi yid ni rab tu bzlog nas kyang*// nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar mdzad du gsol// tshul min yid byed chu rlabs gnyer 'dra ba// kun rtog sna tshogs yul lnga'i rjes su 'brang*// tshogs brgyad bag chags kun gzhir bcas pa kun// chos kyi dbyings su zhi bar mdzad// rtog bcas bag chags 'dod pa'i sems nyon mongs// gsal ba gzugs dang mi rtog gzugs med kyi// srid pa'i sems gang bag chags rjes 'brel ba// de dag thams cad dag par mdzad/ rang don goms pa lhur len dman pa'i blo// gcig pu zhi ba gnyer las bzlog nas kyang*// phyi nang gsang ba'i chos mchog lam zhugs te// rlabs chen gzhan don 'grub par/ lam gol log dang dman pa'i 'gro kun gyi// las dang nyon mongs bag chags rab sbyangs te// sems rta yid bzhin thar pa'i grong khyer du// ma lus phyam gcig bgrod par mdzad= /sgrib pa'i rgya mtsho shin tu rnyog pa can// dus ring thog (466)mtha' med nas nyer gnas pa// bdag cag mthu yis thar pa'i skabs med pas// brtse chen khyod kyis sgrol par= /shugs drag bzod par dka' ba'i nyon mongs dang*// sdug bsngal mang ldan srid pa'i zug rngu dang*// bag med gzhan dbang le lo'i 'jigs pa las// de ring nyid nas nges par bskyab tu gsol// snying nas snying po med pa'i chos rnams la// mi rtags mi brtan sgyu ma'i slu brid du// nges par rtogs nas nges 'byung skyo shas skye// nyin mtshan kun tu 'da' bar mdzad du gsol// 'phags pa'i ri ngogs dben zhing nyams dga' bar// rig dang mngon shes ting nge 'dzin 'grub nas// don gnyis lhun grub bde chen mkha' spyod du// tshe 'di nyid la phyin par mdzad du gsol// gcig pur bsran tshugs sgrub la brtson pa dang*// tshe 'di'i phyogs su skad cig ma yengs shing*// gong ma'i rjes snyogs dngos grub mthar phyin te// rtag tu bla ma mnyes par mdzad=

/dam tshig sdom par nyams chags med pa dang*// lta sgom spyod 'bras ma nor don rtogs nas// nyin mtshan 'od gsal ngang las mi g.yo zhing*// rang gzhan don gnyis 'grub par= /snang srid rnam dag bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin zhing*// mkha' 'gro dam can rgya mtsho sprin bzhin 'du// dngos grub rnam gnyis char bzhin 'babs pa dang*// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par= /dag snang mos gus phyogs med 'char ba dang*// byams dang snying rje rgyun chad med pa dang*// lta sgom nyams rtogs yon tan 'bar ba dang*// 'gro don phyogs med 'grub par= /bdag gis mos dag phun tshogs 'di yis ni// 'gro kun ma lus phyam gcig yongs grol nas// bde chen lhun grub kun tu bzang po'i zhing*// tshe 'di nyid la bgrod par mdzad du gsol//

zhes 'di'ang longs skabs sogs kyis ma lcogs na yang tig dang snying thig brgyud bdebs gter chen rin po ches (467 )mdzad pa tsam byas kyang chog go /de nas dam tshig bzung ba ni thal mo sbyar te/ /bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa dang*// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa ni// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// bla ma la yang skyabs su mchi// sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags// dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyi// rigs lnga'i dam tshig legs bzung ste// rdo rje dril bu la sogs pa// dam tshig rdzas rnams gzung bar bgyi// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// nam du yang ni mi gtong zhing*// rdo rje slob dpon mi spang ngo*// rdo rje spun sring rnams la yang*// nam yang smad par mi bya'o// sems can rnams la 'tshe ba spang*// 'phags pa rnams la smad mi bgyi// theg pa dman la mi brnyas shing*// sngags 'chang spang bar mi bya'o// brnyen sgrub las kyi mtha' bzung zhing*// dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom par bgyi// dam tshig sdom pa la gnas shing*// 'khrul pa'i bya ba mi bgyid do// rang gi sems ni yongs 'dul zhing*// phyogs mthar gtugs pa'i sems can gyi// don ni bla med bdag gis bsgrub// ma grol ba rnams grol ba dang*// ma bsgral ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyung rnams dbugs dbyung zhing*/ sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// ces lan gsum bya/ de nas rjes kyi yan lag bdun pa la 'jug kyang chog la/ gal te tshogs yod na byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i nang mchod 'thor la/ rig pa'i ye shes me rlung chu byung bas// mtshan 'dzin dri ma kun sbyangs stong gsal snod// mkha' mnyam nang du ye shes 'od gsal tshogs// lhun rdzogs 'dod yon ci yang 'char bar gyur// oṃ āḥhūm̐/

lan gsum brjod la tshogs kyi byin 'bebs pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ 'khor (468)'das mnyam nyid thig le brdal ba che// lhun grub rig pa don gyi 'og min nas// sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral med pa'i dpal// rig 'dzin bla ma rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor rnams// nang gsal dbyings la gshegs bzhugs mi mnga' yang*// thugs rje'i gdung thag mos pa'i bu la dgongs// byin chen po la dbang chen rab 'byams skur// snod bcud thams cad rang snang longs sku'i zhing*// dam rdzas ye shes 'khor lor byin rlobs shig /badz+ra sa ma ya ā be sha ya a āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃḥhoḥ de nas tshogs phud 'bul la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ tshangs chen zhing gi phyi snod yangs pa ru// dag dang ma dag snang ba tshogs su spungs// bla ma sprul sku rang byung klong du 'bul// 'khrul snang gzhi thog grol bar mdzad du gsol// rlung lnga'i dwangs bcud 'dus pa'i dbu ma ru// bde chen dga' ba bcu drug dam rdzas bskyil// bla ma longs sku rang gsal kong du 'bul// zag med ye shes rgyas par mdzad du gsol// chos can rtsa bral nam mkha'i klong yangs su// ye grol chos nyid ris med mchod pa'i sprin// bla ma chos sku rang grol klong du 'bul// skye 'chi'i gzhi rtsa stong par mdzad du gsol// mngon sum rang snang sgron ma 'bar ba ru// nyams snang gong 'phel ye shes 'dod yon 'phro// rig pa skur smin bla ma'i tshogs la 'bul// chos zad blo las 'das pa'i dngos grub stsol// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ phyogs bcu'i dus bzhi'i rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma dam pa/ rgyal ba dgongs pas brgyud pa/ rig 'dzin brda yis brgyud pa/ gang zag snyan khung brgyud pa thams cad dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs// mkha' 'gro sde lnga/ dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs dang bcas pa 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i mgron thams cad kyi zhal du gha ṇa tsakra khā hi/ lan gsum 'bul/

bdag (469)cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// sku gsung thugs dang rtsa ba yan lag gi /dam las 'gal zhing nyams pa gyur to 'tshal// rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags// thog med bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// tshor dang ma tshor nyams chags ci mchis pa// thugs rje chen po'i spyan sngar bshags par bgyi// tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// bsnyen sgrub ma tshang phud dang gtsang sbra nyams// dus su ma mchod le lo gsog 'jog bgyis// lta ba ma rtogs sgom pa ma gsal zhing*// spyod pa bag med bgyis pa mthol lo bshags// bla ma mched lcam rdo rje spun la smad// sdig dang nyon mongs rang gar gyur to 'tshal// 'phral dang yun gyi sgrib pa ci mchis pa// rang gnong 'gyod pa'i sems kyis mthol lo= tshangs pa don gyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// ho// rang bzhin ngang la nyes pa'i skyon med pas// bshags dang bshag par bya ba cung zad med// kun rdzob sgyu ma tsam du bshags na yang*// gnyis med sems kyi ngang du dag gyur cig /gnyis su bzung ba rang bzhin nyams pa'i rgyu// gnyis med dbyings su ye nas lhun grub pas// thams cad mkha' mnyam rdzogs pa chen po'i ngang*// ma skyes rnam par dag pa'i chos nyid do// zhes nongs par bshags/ brda dang brda'i 'bul len dang bcas pas rnal 'byor pa rnams nang gi sbyin sreg mngon du byas te tshogs la rol ba ni/ hoḥ bdag lus phung khams skye mched ni// gdan gsum tshang ba'i ngo bo ste// dam pa rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor lha// 'gul bskyod thams cad bde ba che// rdo rje'i dam tshig bla na med// byang chub sems kyi sprin chen po// gnyis med mnyam pa'i ngang du rol// rnal 'byor lam gyi tshogs rdzogs nas// zas kyi sgrib pa mi 'gyur zhing*// gtan pa med pa'i (470)sbyin bdag kyang*// theg chen 'bras bur spyod par shog

/ ces brjod cing bsam pas chos nyid brdal khyab chen po'i ngang du longs spyod la bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi gsung mgur sogs rdo rje'i glu ci rigs pa blang zhing*/ bsdu na nyi zla kha sbyor chen po'i rdo rje'i tshig blang ba ni/ e ma ki ri kī rī/ maṣ+ṭa bā li bā li/ sa mi tra su ru su ru/ ku tā li ma su ma su/ e ka rā su li bha ta ye/ tsa ki ra bhu li sa la ye/ sa mun+ta tsar+ya su gha yai/ bhe ta sa na bh+yaḥku li yai/ sa ka ri dhū ka na/ ma ta ri bai ta na/ bar li hi sa na/ ma khat+ta ki la nī/ saṃ bha ra ta me ka tsiṃt+ta pa/ sur+ya bha ta ra e ba sha na sa/ dran bhi ti sa ghu rā la sa/ ma smin sa gu li ta ya sa/ 'gu rā 'gu rā pag khar na lī/ na ra nā ra/ e tha ra sa ṭa la/ sir na sir ṇā bhe sa ras pa laṃ/ bhun dha bhun dha tshi ṣa pa ke laṃ/ sa sā/ ri rī/ li lī/ i ī/ mi mī/ ra ra rā/ zhes dang*/ ma skyes pas ni mi 'gag cing*// 'gro dang 'ong med kun tu khyab// bde chen chos mchog mi g.yo ba// mkha' mnyam rnam grol dgos pa med// rtsa ba med cing rten med la// gnas med len med chos chen po// ye grol lhun mnyam yangs pa che// bcing med rnam par bkrol med pa// khyab brdal khang bzang ye yod nyid// khyab mnyam sa las rnam 'das pa// yangs po che'o nam mkha'i dbyings// chos chen 'bar ba nyi zla'i dkyil// lhun gyis grub dang mngon sum pa// rdo rje ri bo pad+ma che// nyi ma seng ge ye shes sku// sgra chen rol mo mtshungs pa med// nam mkha'i mtha' la longs spyod pa// sangs rgyas sangs rgyas kun mnyam zhing*// kun bzang yangs pa chos kyi rtse// mkha' dbyings bzang mo'i dbyings rum du// klong gsal lhun grub ye rdzogs che ho// zhes blangs shing zab mo'i don la mnyam par gzhag /mthar lhag ma/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis sbyang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs la/ 'od gsal ye shes yangs pa'i tshogs khang 'dir// kun rtog yul la shar pa'i lhag ma'i mgron// dbang (471)phyug ma mo ging dang laṅka'i tshogs// sgyu 'phrul rol pa tshogs kyi lhag ma bzhes// 'khor ba ru ldog srid pe gting sprugs nas// kun kyang ka dag klong du grol bar mdzod// ma ma hriṃ hriṃ ba ling ta khā hi//

zhes rol mo'i sgra dang bcas te phyi rol tu btang ngo*// rjes la thog mar yan lag bdun pa bsdus te bya ba ni/ phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// dngos dang yid las byung ba yi// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin ni// dpag yas nam mkha'i dbyings khyab pas// mchod 'os kun la mchod par bgyi// rang bzhin mnyam pa'i mchod chen po// mkha' mnyam dri ma med pa yis// rgyal ba kun la rab mchod cing*// dgyes mnyam byang chub ches mchog mchod// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba kun dang dngos kun gyis// 'gro kun yongs mchod sems can kun// yongs grol ye shes mchod pas mchod// phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing rnams su// sangs rgyas sems can gnas kyi bar// bdag gi yid bzhin mchod sprin gyis// rgyun mi chad pa'i mchod sprin shog /lus dang ngag yid sgrib pa kun// mchod 'os kun gyi spyan sngar bshags// slan chad rab tu 'gyod sems kyis// srog gi slad du'ang mi bgyid do// nyan thos byang chub sems dpa' dang*// gsang sngags rig pa 'dzin pa yi// sdom pa gsum dang 'gal ba kun// thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// lus dang ngag dang yid sgo nas// sku dang gsung dang thugs rdo rje// gsang ba gsum dang 'gal gyur pa// thams cad ma lus bshags par bgyi// shes dang mi spang dang du blang*// bsgrub dang spyad pa lnga lnga ste// rtsa ba yan lag nyams chags kun// gnod 'gyod chen pos so sor bshags// bdag ni mi mkhas gti mug pas// 'khor ba ngan song rgyur gyur te// thar pa'i sgrib pa gyur to 'tshal// thams cad bshags kyis dag gyur cig /(472)mkha' mnyam yangs pa chen po'i ngang*// chos rnams rang bzhin rnam dag pas// spang blang med pa'i byang chub sems// chos nyid dbyings su rdzogs gyur cig

/rgyal ba kun dang sems can gyi// dge ba kun la yi rang zhing*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsam pa bzhin// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor du gsol// rgyal dang rgyal sras byang chub sems// 'gro ba'i bla ma mchog kun gyis// ma lus sems can gnas kyi bar// rnam grol mdzad pa gsol ba 'debs// sku tshe lhun po ltar brtan zhing*// ri dbang rgyal po ltar bzhugs nas// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba kun// srid nas zhi bar drang du gsol// las dang nyon mongs rgya mtsho 'dir// dbang med bying ba'i 'gro ba kun// khyed kyi thugs rje'i gru chen gyis// yongs su sgrol bar mdzad du gsol// ma rig mun pa'i tshogs chen po// ye shes zer gyis sol mdzod la// sdug bsngal kun 'byung me tshogs kyis// yongs su gdung ba zhi bar mdzod// mgon med srid pa'i sems can gyi// 'khor ba'i 'khrul 'khor kun gyi gzhi// rten 'brel bcu gnyis shing rta yi// 'phang lo 'dra ba gzhig tu gsol// tshul min yid byed kyis sprul pa'i// spros pa'i 'khor lo gzhom pa dang*// don med 'jig rten bya ba las// bdag gi yid ni ldog tu gsol// nyin dang mtshan mo dus kun tu// sdig sems yid la mi 'gyu zhing*// thar pa'i dge la rab brtson pas// byang chub thob par mdzad du gsol// bskal pa rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed du// rgyal ba kun las mchod pa dang*// dpal mgon bla ma mnyes byed cing*// zab ma'i dam chos 'dzin par shog /rang gzhan don gnyis lhun grub phyir// thos bsam sgom pa lhur len zhing*// nor bdun yon tan phun tshogs te// rtag tu gzhan la phan brtson (473)shog /bdag ni deng nas dus kun tu// 'gro kun nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur te// mthong thos dran reg gyur pa kun// bla med byang chub thob par shog /'ga' zhig khro'am dmar gyur tam// kha zer skur ba 'debs kyang rung*// de dag byang chub rgyur gyur nas// bdag gi gdul bya'i thog mar shog

/gang zhig dad pas bstod gyur ram// mos pas rjes su dran kyang rung*// dngos grub rin chen mdzod brnyes nas// mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlob par shog /bdag la bsten nas gzhan dag gi /nyes kun zad pa'i gzhir gyur te// thar pa'i lam sna zin gyur nas// dge ba 'ba' zhig 'phel bar shog /bdag gi ming tsam bsgrags pas kyang*// sems can kun gyi skyabs byed cing*// gos dang skra sen tsam gyis kyang*// yongs su srung ba chen por shog /gang gis rjes su dran tsam gyis// chom rkun la sogs 'jigs med cing*// ji ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams kun// skad cig nyid la 'grub par shog /bdag ni deng nas phyi ma'i mthar// sems can kun gyi mgon dang skyabs// dpung gnyen byed pa nyid gyur te// re ba thams cad skong bar shog /bdag ni sems can thams cad kyi// yid bzhin nor bu nyid gyur nas// dbul phongs thams cad sel byed cing*// bsam dgu'i re ba 'grub par shog /bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dge ba kun dang thun mong du// yongs su spyad pa'i gzhir gyur te// gzhan don phan pa mtha' yas shog /bdag gi bsam pa thams cad kun// sems can kun gyi don gyur te// dpag med dka' ba bzod pa dang*// gnod len phan pa bsgrub par shog /sems can ji srid gnas kyi bar// bdag gis brtson pas don byed cing*// thams cad 'khor ba las bsgral nas// bdag gis byang chub thob par shog /'od (474)gsal rdo rje snying po'i lam// snang ba bzhi po mthar phyin nas// 'pho ba chen po'i lus bzung ste// gzhan don mtha' yas spyod par shog /bdag la bsten pa'i 'gro ba kun// tshe 'di nyid dam bar do'am// phyi ma sprul sku'i zhing bgrod de// thams cad gdod mar grol bar shog /bdag gis rtsom pa thams cad kun// sems can rnams kyi don gyur te// srid pa'i rgya mtsho rab brgal nas// tshe gcig sangs rgyas 'grub par shog

/rgyal ba kun gyi gsang chen mdzod// bla med mchog gi bstan pa 'di// ji ltar mkha' la nyi shar bzhin// rgyal khams kun tu dar rgyas shog / de nas thugs dam bskul zhing dbang blang ba ni/ bla ma rdo rje 'dzin pa ni// khams gsum 'khor ba'i gnyen gcig po// 'gro ba mgon med rnams kyi skyabs// thar pa'i lam skas chen po ste// ma rig sel ba'i sgron me la// mun pa'i tshogs bdag skyabs su mchi// 'khor ba 'dam gyi mtsho nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// dug gsum me yis gdungs pa la// rang byung rlan gyis bsil bar mdzod// ma rig 'khrul pas bcings pa yi// gdos bcas lus ngag yid rnams kun// rab dongs 'od kyi rang bzhin du// lhag med mya ngan 'das thob mdzod// bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che// bdag la re sa gzhan na med// thugs rje'i spyan gyis gzigs mdzod la// 'khor ba'i mtsho las bsgral du gsol// tshe 'dir legs pa kun 'grub cing*// bgegs dang bar chad med pa dang*// 'chi khar zab mo'i 'od gsal zin// bar do'i 'phrang las sgrol bar mdzod// lus dang ngag yid brtsams pa kun// rtag tu gzhan la phan pa dang*// rkyen rnams byang chub lam mchog tu// de ring nyid nas bsgyur du gsol// bdag gis 'bad kyang thar pa dka'// mgon po khyed kyi thugs rje'i grus// (475)mgon med bdag dang 'gro ba kun// thar pa'i gling du phyin par mdzod// gang dag bdag la dad gyur tam// smod dam skur pa 'debs kyang rung*// de dag sdig zad nyon mongs med// srid pa'i chu bo spang bar shog /nam zhig bdag gi ming tsam gyis// 'gro ba'i 'dod dgu rab sgrub cing*// phyogs bcu gang ba'i zhing rnams su// mchod pa'i sprin gyis char 'bebs shog /dge ba 'di yis lus can kun// thams cad srid las rnam grol nas// ye shes dam pa gnyis thob ste// don gnyis lhun gyis grub par mdzod//

ces gsol ba btab/ snang srid bla ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo thams cad 'od du 'dus te 'khor rnams la thim/ 'khor rnams gtso bo la thim// de nyid dgyes pa chen pos rang gi spyi bor byon zhabs kyi mthe bong las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi spyi bo nas lus phyi nang thams cad la khyab pas lus kyi sgrib pa dag /sku'i dngos grub thob/ mgrin par babs/ ngag gi sgrib pa dag /gsung gi dngos grub thob/ snying khar babs/ yid kyi sgrib pa dag /thugs kyi dngos grub thob/ lte bar babs/ dri ma dag /yon tan gyi dngos grub thob/ gsang bar babs/ phrin las kyi dngos grub thob/ bla ma dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu ste rang la thim pas bla ma'i sku gsung thugs dang rang gi lus ngag yid gsum dbyer med du gyur par mos la ka dag rang gsal chen po'i dgongs pa'i klong du mnyam par gzhag go /de las ldang ba na/ snang ba thams cad bla ma'i sku// grags pa thams cad bla ma'i gsung*// dran rig thams cad bla ma'i thugs// snod bcud ye shes rol pa'o// zhes mos la/ dge ba 'di yis myur tu bdag /dpal ldan bla ma 'grub gyur sogs bsngo ba ji ltar rigs pas rgyas gdab/ sa gzhi dang bar (476) snang thams cad bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs dam can rgya mtsho sprin phung 'khrigs pas me tog gi char 'bebs shing shis pa brjod par bsams la mgrin gcig tu/ bkra shis gang zhig dbyings las mi g.yo lhun gyis grub// sku dang ye shes 'du 'bral gnyis med rdzogs sangs rgyas// gdod ma'i mgon po 'khor 'das kun gyi dpal gyur pa// kun tu bzang po rigs lnga'i rgyal ba rgyal mtshor bcas// ma lus yongs gang bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog /'od gsal snying po spros kun nyer zhi mchog gi lam// rnam par dkar la so sor ma 'dres dri ma bral// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul rgya che ba// dam chos nyi ma'i bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog

/rnam grol yid bzhin mdzod mnga' 'gro ba'i bsod nams shing*// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rig 'dzin dam can rgya mtshor bcas// 'jig rten las grub mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba// dngos grub mchog stsol bkra shis des kyang bde legs shog / ces pa la sogs pa brjod pa'i mtshams su me tog gi char dbab cing rol mo'i sgra dang bcas bya'o// 'di phyi'i bde legs bla ma mchod las byung*// dam tshig sdom pa kun gyi rtsa ba yin// nyams rtogs yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin rgyas par byed// dge sbyor kun gyi gtso bor 'dir 'bad rigs// de phyir grub mtha' kun la grags che ba'i// thun mong bla ma mchod pa'i tshul 'di ni// kun mkhyen ngag gi dbang po'i gsung rab las// skal bzang rnams kyis nyams su blangs bder bsdebs// dge bas bdag gzhan 'gro ba ma lus pa// yang dag bla ma mchog gis rjes bzung ste// tshe lus gcig gis gdod ma'i sar thob nas// dpag med sprul pas mkha' mnyam 'gro sgrol shog /ces pa'ang rang gzhan tshogs pa'i cha rkyen nyer mkhor gyur ba dang*/ kun mkhyen rdo rje gzi brjid gnyis pas kyang dmigs dbang med pa'i thugs rjes bka'i lung stsal ba las/ nges don bstan pa'i bdag po karma tā'i si tu'i 'bangs tha kun bzang bka' brgyud la gdod nas smon lam gyis 'brel ba karma ngag dbang yon tan rgya mtsho blo gros mtha' yas pa'i (477) sdes dpal chen po'i 'od gsal thugs kyi dkyil 'khor de bī ko ṭa'i snying po tsā 'dra rin chen brag gi sgrub gnas su kun mkhyen dri med 'od zer gdod ma'i grol sar mngon par byang chub pa'i dus chen bzang por sbyar ba dge legs 'phel/// / (478)
